# ConjuGo

> An iOS app for French verb conjugation. Short daily drills adapt to the forms you
> personally get wrong, using spaced repetition, rather than showing you a table to
> read. For English-speaking learners around A2–B2, where conjugation becomes the
> bottleneck.

Download: {{ site.app_store_url }}
Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 18.6 or later. No Android or web version exists.
Price: free 7-day trial, then $3.99/month or $24.99/year. No advertising.

## What it actually does

- Drills 6,000+ French verbs, including irregular and reflexive verbs.
- Covers five tenses: présent, passé composé, imparfait, futur simple, conditionnel
  présent. It is deliberately not a 17-tense reference — subjonctif and passé simple
  are not included.
- Picks what to ask using a spaced-repetition engine that tracks every verb, tense and
  pronoun separately, so weak forms return more often.
- Exercise formats rotate: free recall, fill-in-the-blank in real sentences, être vs
  avoir, full paradigms, and matching pairs.
- Includes plain-English grammar guides, verb search with full conjugation tables,
  timed speed drills, streaks, and progress statistics.
- Practice works offline after first sign-in.

## Who it suits

Learners who can recognise a conjugation but freeze when they have to produce one:
exam candidates (DELF, DALF, AP French, IB), people living or working in French, and
returning learners. It is a focused verb trainer, not a general language course, so it
complements rather than replaces apps like Duolingo.
